title: Top-k SAE feature logical experts with a learned input router
hypothesis: For 16 relation behaviors on pinned Pythia-70m, a learned router selecting one of 16 task-specific OMP16 SAE feature experts from the input-token hidden state can approach the same-router explicit-FV expert bank within .10 gold-logprob nats/.05 accuracy while using <=.60x its total router-plus-expert payload and no more than global per-expert SAE OMP16 bytes.
physical_object: Pinned Pythia-70m and pretrained tied 2048-atom layer-3 SAE dictionary.
mirror_coordinate: Input-conditioned expert address selecting one sparse 16-feature SAE intervention code; one residual feature pool of 64 SAE atoms is shared across 16 logical experts.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen relation-task intervention experts, top-1 routed per query; this is task coverage, not independent capacity inferred from address combinations.

task.primary_metric: mean held-out gold candidate log probability after routing

router.input: Layer-4 final hidden state at the prompt prefix `Input: {x}\nOutput:` with no demonstrations; inference uses only the query input.
router.fit_data: Eight support source inputs per task from the same development seed; support examples remain disjoint from evaluator queries.
router.architecture: Single affine 512-to-16 softmax classifier over standardized features; training mean/std are fit on support inputs, stored FP32 with the affine weights/biases; argmax top-1 expert.
router.optimization: Full-batch cross-entropy Adam, lr=.01, exactly 1000 updates, zero weight decay; no tuning.

experts.pool_selection: Residual-correlation greedy shared pool of 64 SAE atoms over 16 support-derived task FVs; deterministic stable ties.
experts.code: Deterministic signed OMP16 over the selected pool for each task; FP32 coefficients, uint8 local indices and uint16 global pool IDs.
experts.execution: Decode only the router-selected task code to one 512D intervention vector before applying it to the query; do not store decoded vectors.

controls: One shared mean intervention with the same router-independent evaluator
Oracle-task-routed explicit FP32 FV expert bank (upper routing quality)
Learned-router explicit FP32 FV expert bank
Learned-router global SAE OMP16 per-task sparse expert lists (native sparse experts)
Learned-router residual-selected shared-pool64 OMP16 feature experts (Mirror candidate)

fresh.opening_rule: Only if both dev seeds pass router, causal-quality and actual total-payload gates.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all per-task code indices and coefficients
full SAE artifact for standalone SAE deployment
explicit FV bank and global sparse expert lists
router support-feature mean and standard deviation
storage.reporting: Compare complete router+expert state, expert-only state, incremental-over-preloaded-SAE bytes, and standalone Pythia+SAE+expert system. Count all routing metadata.

compute.active_compute_proxy: Report router 512x16 fit/prediction, pool construction and OMP coding, selected expert decode, and transformer candidate-sequence work separately.

gates.PASS: Both dev seeds: router accuracy >=.75; learned-router Mirror within .05 candidate accuracy and .10 gold-logprob nats of learned-router explicit-FV expert bank; full router+expert payload <=.60x learned-router explicit-FV total and <= global OMP16 total; fresh remains unopened until then.
gates.FAIL: Any frozen route, causal-quality or payload gate fails.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Pinned artifact/split integrity or deterministic replay fails.

boundaries: One Pythia-70m model, one SAE checkpoint and 16 relation tasks only.
Router accuracy is reported separately from conditional expert quality.
Oracle routing is an upper control, not a deployable claim.
Full SAE bytes are charged for standalone deployment.
No claim of 16 independent experts follows from 16 route labels or code combinations.
